id.help: Unique id; maps, research, factions and jobs name it.

glyph.help: One letter shown when there is no art.

moveType.help: How the unit moves over terrain.

stats.help: Base value per stat of the game.

maxLevel.help: Level cap of this type (0 = never levels; needs progression).

wields.help: Weapon groups the unit can use (carried weapons).

items.help: Items a unit of this type starts with (carried items).

tags.help: Free words that skills and filters test.

resist.help: Flat resistance per damage type (whole numbers within resistRange).

skills.help: Skills the unit type always has.

learns.help: Skills learned on reaching a level (needs progression).

level.help: Level at which it is learned (2 up to the max level).

abilities.help: Menu abilities of this unit type.

promotions.help: Classes it can promote to (docs/SRPG.md Promotion).

atLevel.help: off: only by item or story; offer: asked at the level; auto: happens at the level.

items.help: Promotion items (promotes: true) that do it.

ranks.help: Starting weapon rank per weapon group (needs data/ranks.json).

caps.help: Highest value per stat for this type (needs data/caps.json).

pairBonus.help: Pair-up bonus of this type (needs rules.rescue pairUp; not the hit points stat).

vision.help: Sight in squares under fog of war.

fuelPerTurn.help: Fuel used each turn (needs fuel; less than fuel).

supplies.help: Refills the fuel and ammunition of neighbours.

ap.help: Action-point overrides for this type (needs rules.actionPoints).

step.help: Points per square for this type.

softCap.help: Movement points at plain price for this type.

jump.help: Height jump of this type: one number, or separate up and down (needs rules.height).

sounds.help: Sound ids by event (step, attack ...; docs/SOUND.md).
